notes.title: Quick Update on the game!
notes.content:
Hi All,

Apologies for the radio silence over the last few months, I've had a lot of stuff going on that has kept me away from my PC, so I've not been able to put much time into the development of the game.

However, things are back to normal now and I'm developing a new UI for the next update. This interface update will add:

[list]
[*] Controller Support for menus
[*] VR Support
[*] Improved control customisation
[*] New menu and interface art style
[/list]

So more specifically, I've moved to a new city and have been slowly moving stuff over the during last three months and dealing with all the things that go along with that, so my machine has been out of reach for a while. I was also ill for a while after exhibiting the game at Play Expo in Manchester (nothing serious but it didn't help things). I'm sorry for the massive gap in updates, sadly this is one of the difficulties and dangers of solo game development; any issues can cause a total delay in development. 

Everything is set up again now and I'm back into developing the game, so I'd like to apologise for the lack of content and reassure everyone that the game isn't dead (I understand that it looked that way due to the lack of updates, but my new situation means I can continue to work on the game for a long while yet). 

Thanks for your patience!
Jack

notes.title: Photo Mode Hotfix and new livery
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32058476/245b3cc131da13b636ef1a84500c36f28ed93ec5.jpg[/img]

Hi Everyone,

I've just updated the game to fix an issue with screenshots. Previously if you used the in game method of grabbing a screenshot the game wouldn't save it as the directory path was incorrect (it was looking at directories on my PC). I've now updated it to use Steam's screenshot system so you can now press the Y/Triangle button or F12 to take Steam screenshots.

I've also added a new livery to the DTG to replace the green livery. This new skin is in aid of Manchester Gamers Unite who will be hosting an event in Manchester at Impossible Bar on the 26th March (starting at 18:00). I'll be there as well as a load of cool indie games so if your in the area, drop by! Here's a link for tickets: https://www.eventbrite.co.uk/e/gamers-unite-2019-launch-party-tickets-54260486576

Apologies if any of you encountered the screenshot issue, but this should now be resolved!

Thanks,
Jack

notes.title: Early Access Update 4 - New Sweden Stage!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32058476/540fe917d2cbfad33d7631369ec64ecb31499e3a.jpg[/img]


Hi Everyone!

I've added a new Sweden track to the game! It's a very fast, wide and simple circuit that lends itself well to the MDX and PD cars. It should prove to be a nice change of pace from the technicality of the Japan stage as it features (possibly) the longest straight in the game. 

Apologies for the delay with this update, it took longer than I would have liked to get this stage ready, so thanks for your patience. This update now brings the first Early Access phase to a close, so Phase Two will be about improving the game through bugfixes, polish, new menus and VR support.

Here's a list of additional changes in this update:

[list]
[*] Car physics have been updated to be more consistent across different frame rates
[*] LODs updated for lots of common meshes to improve performance
[*] Temporarily removed tyre decals as they caused a massive drop in performance
[*] Updated lighting and fog on all stages
[*] Updated interior textures to improve performance
[*] Car handling tweaks for DTG and PDX1
[/list]

The next phase of development will focus on bug fixes (until the beginning of April) then I will be completely overhauling the menus and UI. This will include menu support for controllers and allow for VR support. It should also help establish the overall tone and style of the game I'm aiming for. 

Thanks!
Jack

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32058476/301556ae56c9fb5ab5fb75faa3e82400b9b87b71.jpg[/img]

notes.title: ZEROCAR: Future Motorsport - Week One fixes
notes.content:
Over the last week I've added the following changes and fixes to the game:

- Added VSync option to the Main Menu > Graphics screen.
- Added social media links
- Updated leaderboard addresses for Solar Road
- Updated leaderboard addresses for Connect Raceway
- Updated leaderboard address for Halken Full Reverse Standard Class
- Updated time of day lighting
- Updated wrong way detection system
- Fixed minuites, seconds, and milliseconds from being displayed incorrectly on the leaderboard screen
- Fixed leaderboard user Steam IDs being invalidated when grabbing leaderboard times
- Added "Remove local saved time" option for removing corrupted times

Currently I'm investigating freezes, crashes and corrupt times being added to the leaderboard. Unfortunately I only have two machines to test on, so you may still encounter issues on your setup. Let me know if you do as it will help me identify where things are going wrong.

I will also be adding a project roadmap this weekend, so you can see what I have planned for ZEROCAR: Future Motorsport. When this is up and running I will also outline the ideas I have for involving the community in the game's development.


Thanks for your patience regarding the above bugs and issues, I hope you are enjoying the game!

Jack
